_comment: Example GDPR policy — point GDPR_POLICY_FILE at a copy to enable. Demonstrates each classification, the role ladder, and pseudonymisation. The shipped default (no file) is benign: everything public, one public role, no pseudonymisation.

classification_rules._comment: Anything under a restricted/ source prefix is embedded but gated to internal/admin roles.
Internal design notes — visible to internal/admin, not the public chat.
Any doc whose text carries a national ID pattern is PII: never embedded, never stored.
